series.name: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)
series.notes: Older grey-cased single/two/three-phase TL bodies (e.g. 5000MTL, 10000TL, 20000TL3-HE) that predate the 2xx/3xx/4xx scheme. Source is Growatt's own Troubleshooting Guide issued by Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd (ausupport@ginverter.com, Silverwater NSW). Codes here are 1xx ONLY and mean DIFFERENT things from every other series - e.g. 116 = EEPROM, 117 = Relay, 118 = Init model, 122 = Bus voltage, whereas on MOD/WIT 116-122 are not published at all. Still very common on net-metered installs in Pakistan.

meaning.en: The inverter's internal voltage reference has drifted, so measurements are untrustworthy.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal voltage reference bekar chala hai, is liye readings par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Reference voltage circuit on the control board has drifted
causes.ur: Control board ka reference voltage circuit bekar chala hai

causes.en: Auxiliary supply out of tolerance feeding the reference
causes.ur: Reference ko chalane wali auxiliary supply tolerance se bahar

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait for the DC bus to discharge, then reboot the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke DC bus discharge hone tak wait karein, phir inverter reboot karein.

solutions.en: Measure the auxiliary supply rails against the board's own markings before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: Board fault maan ne se pehle board ke apne markings ke against auxiliary supply rails measure karein.

solutions.en: If the code survives a reboot, contact Growatt to claim warranty - Growatt's own guide treats it as a warranty item.
solutions.ur: Agar code reboot ke baad bhi rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein - Growatt ka apna guide isay warranty item kehta hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

title.ur: Processor aapas mein baat nahi kar rahe (101 / 102 / 121)

meaning.en: The master processor cannot receive data from the slave processor - Growatt groups 101, 102 and 121 as one communication fault.
meaning.ur: Master processor slave processor se data nahi le sakta - Growatt 101, 102 aur 121 ko aik hi communication fault ke tor par group karta hai.

causes.en: Control board internal processor bus fault
causes.ur: Control board ka internal processor bus fault

causes.en: Internal harness or processor solder joint failure
causes.ur: Internal harness ya processor solder joint fail

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reboot the inverter once.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke inverter ek baar reboot karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, follow Growatt's guide: reboot then claim warranty through Growatt service.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to Growatt ke guide ke mutabiq karein: reboot karke Growatt service se warranty claim karein.

solutions.en: Before claiming, note the exact time the code appears - recurring codes on a cold morning point to a marginal processor.
solutions.ur: Claim karne se pehle note karein ke code kab aata hai - subah ke waqt baar baar aane wala code marginal processor ki taraf ishara karta hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

meaning.en: The neutral conductor is carrying voltage, which points to a reversed or damaged connection.
meaning.ur: Neutral conductor par voltage aa raha hai, jo ulatay ya damaged connection ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: N and L conductors connected in reverse at the inverter
causes.ur: Inverter par N aur L conductors ulat se lage hain

causes.en: Inverter terminal block damaged, or neutral conductor open upstream
causes.ur: Inverter terminal block damaged, ya neutral conductor upstream se khul gaya hai

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and isolate, then test the N line and the L line for reversal.
solutions.ur: AC breaker band karke isolate karein, phir N line aur L line ka reversal test karein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter terminals for damage, and measure N-to-PE voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Inverter terminals par damage check karein, aur multimeter se N se PE voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If a damaged spot is found, contact Growatt for a warranty replacement of the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Agar damaged spot mil jaye to terminal block ki warranty replacement ke liye Growatt se rabta karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

meaning.en: Failure reading or writing the EEPROM settings memory.
meaning.ur: EEPROM settings memory parhne ya likhne mein failure.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or its solder joint on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par EEPROM chip ya uska solder joint

causes.en: Power interruption during a settings write
causes.ur: Settings write ke dauran power chala jana

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter after disconnecting AC and PV.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV disconnect kar ke inverter reboot karein.

solutions.en: Note whether the fault only appears in the morning - a marginal EEPROM chip does exactly that.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke fault sirf subah aata hai ya nahi - marginal EEPROM chip aise hi karta hai.

solutions.en: If sustained after reboot, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Reboot ke baad bhi barqarar rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

meaning.en: The grid connection relay circuit is not operating correctly.
meaning.ur: Grid connection relay circuit theek se operate nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Relay coil, contacts or its driver circuit faulty
causes.ur: Relay coil, contacts ya uska driver circuit faulty

causes.en: Relay failed after an arc or over-voltage event
causes.ur: Arc ya over-voltage event ke baad relay fail

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then listen for the relay click when the AC breaker is toggled.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke AC breaker toggle karte waqt relay ki click check karein.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter once; a single click with a cleared code means an interlock event.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar reboot karein; sirf ek click aur code clear ho jaye to interlock event hai.

solutions.en: If the relay never clicks, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar relay kabhi click na kare to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

title.ur: Init model fault - dip switches ghalat hain

meaning.en: The dip switches underneath the inverter do not match the model, so initialisation fails.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke neeche ke dip switches model se match nahi karte, is liye initialisation fail hai.

causes.en: Dip switch block moved during service or transport
causes.ur: Service ya transport ke doraan dip switch block hila diya gaya

causes.en: Wrong dip switch combination fitted for the installed model
causes.ur: Installed model ke liye ghalat dip switch combination laga hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then read the dip switches underneath the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke inverter ke neeche dip switches padhein.

solutions.en: Set the dip switches per section 1.2.1 of Growatt's own guide, and re-check each position.
solutions.ur: Growatt ke apne guide ke section 1.2.1 ke mutabiq dip switches set karein, aur har position dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the code persists with correct switches, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Sahi switches ke saath bhi code rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

title.ur: GFCI device damage ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The ground fault detection device is damaged.
meaning.ur: Ground fault detection device kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: GFCI board damaged by surge or repeated leakage trips
causes.ur: Surge ya baar baar leakage trips se GFCI board kharab

causes.en: Undetected earth fault in the array still energising the device
causes.ur: Array mein abhi bhi undetected earth fault mojood hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure array insulation resistance before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke board fault maan ne se pehle array ki insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the GFCI board for scorch marks or a burnt smell.
solutions.ur: GFCI board par burnt nishaan ya burnt smell dekhein.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter; if the fault remains, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Inverter reboot karein; fault bacha rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

title.ur: HCT fault - hall current transformer ka masla

meaning.en: The hall-effect current transformer or its circuit is reporting a fault.
meaning.ur: Hall-effect current transformer ya uska circuit fault report kar raha hai.

causes.en: Hall current sensor failed or its connector loose
causes.ur: Hall current sensor fail ya uska connector loose

causes.en: Sensor wiring harness damaged near the fan or heatsink
causes.ur: Sensor wiring harness fan ya heatsink ke paas damaged

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then reseat the HCT connector at the control board.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke control board par HCT connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Compare current readings with a clamp meter; a HCT reading far from clamp-meter truth means the sensor is dead.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se current readings compare karein; agar HCT reading clamp meter se bohat door ho to sensor dead hai.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter; if the fault persists, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Inverter reboot karein; fault bacha rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is abnormal, commonly from ageing capacitors or a failing power circuit.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage abnormal hai, aksar aging capacitors ya failing power circuit ki wajah se.

causes.en: DC bus capacitors ageing, giving excessive ripple
causes.ur: DC bus capacitors aging ho kar bohat zyada ripple de rahe hain

causes.en: Failure in the power circuit that charges the bus
causes.ur: Bus ko charge karne wali power circuit mein failure

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then wait 5 minutes for the bus to discharge safely.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein taake bus mehfooz taur par discharge ho.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter and watch whether the code returns at every start or only under load.
solutions.ur: Inverter reboot karke dekhein ke code har start par aata hai ya sirf load ke saath.

solutions.en: If it returns immediately, contact Growatt to claim warranty - Growatt's guide routes all 1xx codes to warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar foran wapas aaye to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein - Growatt ka guide tamam 1xx codes ko warranty par bhejta hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)
